+"""Intent tests for mdata.validate_rows (M1-T14, DATA-02, TC-01)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+
+from mdata import RawRow, validate_rows
+
+
+def _rows_from_triples(triples: list[list]) -> list[RawRow]:
+    return [RawRow(date=d, ticker=t, close=c) for d, t, c in triples]
+
+
+def _rows_from_sample(sample: dict) -> list[RawRow]:
+    return [RawRow(date=r["date"], ticker=r["ticker"], close=r["close"]) for r in sample["rows"]]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_tc01_unusable_rows_dropped_later_duplicate_kept_sorted(golden):
+    inp, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-01")
+    rows = _rows_from_triples(inp["rows"])
+
+    result = validate_rows(rows, inp["tickers"])
+
+    # Tolerance: exact.
+    assert result == _rows_from_triples(expected["rows"])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_tc01_result_is_a_list_of_raw_rows(golden):
+    inp, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-01")
+    rows = _rows_from_triples(inp["rows"])
+
+    result = validate_rows(rows, inp["tickers"])
+
+    assert isinstance(result, list)
+    assert len(result) == len(expected["rows"])
+    assert all(isinstance(r, RawRow) for r in result)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_tc01_tickers_default_matches_none(golden):
+    inp, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-01")
+    rows = _rows_from_triples(inp["rows"])
+
+    assert validate_rows(rows) == _rows_from_triples(expected["rows"])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_requested_ticker_absent_raises_key_error_naming_it(contract_sample):
+    rows = _rows_from_sample(contract_sample("mdata.RawRow"))
+
+    with pytest.raises(KeyError, match="ZZZ"):
+        validate_rows(rows, ["AAA", "ZZZ"])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.intent
+def test_requested_ticker_with_only_unusable_rows_raises_key_error_naming_it(contract_sample):
+    sample_rows = _rows_from_sample(contract_sample("mdata.RawRow"))
+    # Keep every AAA row, and only BBB's blank-close row, so BBB has no usable row.
+    rows = [r for r in sample_rows if r.ticker == "AAA" or r.close is None]
+    assert any(r.ticker == "BBB" for r in rows)
+
+    with pytest.raises(KeyError, match="BBB"):
+        validate_rows(rows, ["AAA", "BBB"])
